issues.jp_before: 今[いま]何時[なんじ]{か|ka-embedded}知[し]っていますか{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: Sentence-final か written both as text and as a slot, so the sentence reads 知っていますかか.
issues.action: Removed the literal か before the slot. Same fix on the lines with 分かりますか, 覚えていますか, 知っていますか (x4) and いただけませんか (9 lines in total).

issues.jp_before: 明日[あした]誰[だれ]{が|ga-question}来[く]る{か|ka-embedded}分[わ]かりません。
issues.problem: lv 5, but embedded-question か is N4 grammar.
issues.action: lv set to 4. Same change on the 駅はどこか, 今何時か, 先生は学生に何を読んだか, どんな音楽が好きか and 雨が降るかどうか lines.

issues.jp_before: 財布[さいふ]{を|o-object}どこ{に|ni-location}置[お]いた{か|ka-embedded}忘[わす]れました。
issues.problem: に with 置く marks where the object ends up, not where it exists (ni-location covers ある/いる/住む).

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{が|ga-subject}どんな音楽[おんがく]{が|ga-stative}好[す]き{か|ka-embedded}知[し]っていますか{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: 彼は is just as natural here (topic of the whole sentence), so the alternative was missing; there was also a doubled か.
issues.action: Slot changed to {が/は|ga-subject}. Same alternative added to the 彼女がなぜ怒っているか, 彼女がパーティーに来るかどうか and 彼が日本語が話せるかどうか lines.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は/が|wa-topic}いつ{まで|made-until}日本[にほん]{に|ni-location}いる{か|ka-embedded}まだ決[き]めていません。
issues.problem: English 'until when he will stay' is unnatural.
issues.action: en changed to 'He hasn't decided yet how long he will stay in Japan.'

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{の|no-possessive}説明[せつめい]{が|ga-subject}理解[りかい]できた{かどうか/か|ka-embedded}自分[じぶん]{で|de-means}考[かんが]えてみてください。
issues.problem: 自分で ('by yourself') is not de-means (means, tool, transport or language); no catalog skill fits it.
issues.action: Replaced 自分で with もう一度 and changed the English to 'Think again about whether...'.

issues.jp_before: 病院[びょういん]{へ/に|ni-destination}行[い]く{かどうか/か|ka-embedded}まだ迷[まよ]っています。
issues.problem: The skill is ni-destination but へ was listed as the first answer.
